title: Resolve call
description: The body of the control plane's call with the path resolve, a POST of application/json to the adapter's call_url followed by resolve (adapter.schema.json), signed as definitions.schema.json describes a call: which grant and which resource at the source cover each of addresses, and whether the source shows that resource to anyone without a credential. An address is written as the document the control plane read it from writes it, such as an https URL or the form user@host:path, so it is a bounded string and not a URL of $defs. The adapter answers a signed 200 with resolve-answer.schema.json. It reads each address itself. It answers public: true for an address whose resource the source shows to anyone without a credential, decided from the visibility of the resource as a request without a credential sees it, never from a grant it holds; a resource that the source shows only to signed-in users is not public. It answers covered: false for an address it cannot read, or that no grant it holds covers and whose resource is not public; an address that the adapter cannot read is never a refusal. The control plane sends a call with the path read-public only for a resource_ref that the adapter answered with public: true, and never sends a call with the path run-credential for a resource that it reads with the call with the path read-public: reading a public resource gives the run no credential. The adapter refuses a call whose time is more than 300 seconds from its clock, either way, or whose signature it has already seen, with an unsigned 401; definitions.schema.json has the replay rule. A member this schema does not define is refused, invalid_request.

version.description: The document format. The adapter refuses a version it does not read.

time.description: When the control plane built the body, RFC 3339 in UTC with whole seconds. The adapter refuses a time more than 300 seconds from its clock, either way, with an unsigned 401.

addresses.description: The addresses, 1 to 64, none twice, each 1 to 2048 printable ASCII characters with no space.

address.description: An address as a document writes it: 1 to 2048 printable ASCII characters with no space.
